definition.en: Measures of inflation are statistical tools used to track the rate at which the general level of prices for goods and services in an economy is rising.
definition.hi: Measures of inflation are statistical tools used to track the rate at which the general level of prices for goods and services in an economy is rising.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding inflation indices is critical for GS-3 as they form the basis of monetary policy decisions by the RBI. Aspirants must grasp these measures to analyze economic stability, purchasing power, and the impact of government fiscal policies.
